description: This mod adds a pickaxe which is able to mine bedrock. It is hard to obtain and in survival you can only get cracked bedrock (which can be mined with anything)

mods.name: Bedrockite
mods.description:
§rThis mod adds a new material §bBedrockite §rthat you can use to make the §bBedrockite pickaxe §rwhich is able to mine bedrock. It is hard to obtain and in survival you can only get cracked bedrock (which can be mined with anything)

§6If you find any issue please report it! https://github.com/Miki85cz/BedrockiteMod/issues

releases.notes:
Changes:
 * Added advancements
 * Added compability with Create
 * Fixed tags of bedrock_cracks

This version is almost done, but it still needs some more testing. You can try this version but baybe it still has some bugs.

**IF YOU WANT TO TRY THIS VERSION ON YOUR WORLD MAKE SURE TO MAKE A BACKUP!!!**

It supports neoforge 1.21 and 1.21.1
